title: Rising R&B Artist Charli Fletcher Highlights Body Empowerment On New Single "Pow Wow"
htmlContent:
Charli Fletcher is a fast-rising R&B artist with a lot to offer. Her lyrics are typically a standout point and will draw listeners in thanks to the broad range of topics she sings about, such as overcoming adversities, love and body confidence. Body confidence is the theme of her latest single, “Pow Wow”, and it’ll have you feeling comfortable in your own skin and ready to take on the world after listening to it.

Charli’s vocals are captivating – with her sing-rap flow gliding effortlessly over the lo-fi R&B beat produced by Imperial No Drama. The track is further boosted by its stunning music video (directed by Charli Fletcher and Anton Califano), which features different types of women and complements the track’s focus on body positivity.

Speaking on the concept behind the track, Charli says, “It’s a song that embodies body empowerment but also explores different qualities about me that are not just physical. My friend Imperial No Drama, who is a brilliant producer, sent me the instrumental, and it was called ‘Body Like Wow’. The energy of the beat was very sexy and slow, so I just vibed with it.”

Stay connected with Charli Fletcher via Instagram.
